ci.yml.plan-test:
name: the planner's own test
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python3 ci/tiers-test.py
ci.yml.linux:
name: linux x86-64 (every gate)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            .wolf-bin
            target/oracle
          key: den-linux-${{ hashFiles('wolf-toolchain.toml', 'den-oracle.toml', 'ci/oracle.Containerfile', 'tools/fetch-oracle.py') }}
      - name: every gate inside the pinned Ubuntu container
        env:
          DEN_ENGINE: docker
          DEN_CPUS: 0-3
        run: tools/in-container tools/gate
      - name: evidence, including failures
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: linux-evidence
          path: |
            target/*checked.json
            target/codec*.log
            target/codec/*.json
            target/codec-corpus/summary.json
            target/codec-fuzz/summary.json
            target/corpus/oids.json
            target/runs
            target/dist/sums.txt
ci.yml.macos:
name: macOS Homebrew git field leg (nonblocking)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: brew install git
      - name: field observation, not oracle parity
        id: field
        continue-on-error: true
        run: tools/field
      - name: record field result
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        run: echo 'Homebrew field result ${{ steps.field.outcome }}' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: macos-field-evidence
          path: target/runs
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - macos
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: every chosen job succeeded, every other was skipped
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 ci/tiers.py verdict

  # A red nightly opens an issue (ruling #92): a scheduled run has no lane
  # watching it, so the red has to come and find one. One open issue per
  # workflow, its title the dedupe key (ci/nightly-red.sh).
ci.yml.nightly-red:
name: nightly red, an issue
    needs: tier
    if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: open or update the nightly-red issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: ci/nightly-red.sh
